title: Records related to Israel Institute Teaching Fellows, 2024-present

communications.subject: California Public Records Act Request: Records related to Israel Institute Teaching Fellows, 2024-present
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

1- all email correspondence to/from the Director of the Center for Jewish Studies email address containing the keywords "Israel Institute," or discussing the placement of a Israel Institute Teaching Fellows to offer courses at UC Berkeley, from January 1, 2024 to the date of this request's fulfillment;

2- all email correspondence to/from the Chair of Middle Eastern Languages and Cultures email address containing the keywords "Israel Institute," or discussing the placement of a Israel Institute Teaching Fellows to offer courses at UC Berkeley, from January 1, 2024 to the date of this request's fulfillment;

3- all gift agreements between the Israel Institute and UC Berkeley, from January 1, 2024 to the date of this request's fulfillment.

4- any offer letters, position descriptions, and hiring paperwork regarding the placement of Israel Institute teaching fellows at UC Berkeley, from January 1, 2024 to the date of this request's fulfillment.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Ed Burton
